# Patent watchlist for jubilant-bassoon.
#
# One term per line, no double quotes. Lines starting with # are ignored, and a
# repeated term is read once.
#
# Each term is searched on USPTO Patent Public Search for the grant Tuesday
# (database USPAT) and the publication Thursday before it (US-PGPUB), in two forms
# (.github/scripts/patent_watch.py):
#   "<term>".as.   the term is the patent's assignee or applicant
#   "<term>"       the term appears anywhere in the document
# A hit says which form found it. The first is the precise one; the second also
# finds patents that only mention the term. A term that matches more than 500
# families on one day is refused, not cut short.
#
# Run weekly via .github/workflows/patent-watch.yml on Wednesday 16:00 UTC.
